reason: A DSH settings plugin that provides an archive-management page for viewing, filtering, sorting, unarchiving, and permanently deleting archived chat sessions; permanent filesystem deletion makes this a high-risk data-management utility.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 设置新增归档管理页面，用于按工作区查看、筛选、排序、取消归档和永久删除已归档会话。
summaries.en: Adds an archive-management page to DSH settings for viewing, filtering, sorting, unarchiving, and permanently deleting archived sessions by workspace.

capabilities: Adds an archive page to DSH settings
Lists archived sessions grouped by workspace
Permanently deletes individual or all archived session logs and metadata
Registers same-origin HTTP routes for archive operations
